name: Arnim Zola

abilityDetails.Pre-Fight: Dövüş başlamadan önce Pre-Fight ekranından değiştirilebilen yetenek.
abilityDetails.Cowardice: Özel saldırı hasarını belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Sleep: Uyuyan şampiyonlar saldıramaz, bloklayamaz veya hareket edemez; vurulduklarında bu etki kalkar.
abilityDetails.Disintegration: Aktifken doğrudan hasar verir; etkilenen şampiyonun güç kazanım oranını azaltır.
abilityDetails.Energize: Muharebe Güç Oranını belirtilen güçte artırır.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Bloklayınca (3) veya ağır olmayan vuruşla vurulunca (1) yük kazanır; 20 yükte %10 şansla 3sn pasif uyku uygular (uyurken tamamen savunmasız kalırsın). Ağır saldırıyla yere serilince 10 yük kaybeder — sık ağır saldırı kullanan şampiyonlar en iyi cevap; ağır saldırı yüklerken pasif sersemletme uygulayanlar direkt kontra. Görünmezlik veya durdurulamazlık olan şampiyonlar da güvenle ağır saldırı kullanabilir.
signatureAbility:
Grasp of Hydra
Upgrades to his intricate neural network grant Zola the #Psychic Shielding tag while in a fight.
Striking a Sleeping Opponent grants Zola an Unblockable Passive for [2.8 - 12] seconds.
When Zola's Special Attacks remove his Disintegration Debuffs, each Debuff deals a final burst of [491.27 - 987.5] Direct Damage.

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Advanced robotics provides Immunity to Bleed and Poison, and Zola's Ability Accuracy and Combat Power Rate can only be modified by his own effects.
The Critical Penetration of the Opponent's Basic Attacks is reduced by -80% flat, and Zola cannot lose more than 10% of his Max Health from a single damage source, other than a Special Attack 3.
Zola's first Medium and first Light Attacks are kinetic pulses that do not make contact.

abilitySections.title: Systems of Control
content: Zola can activate a Pre-Fight Ability to select either a Special 1 Lock or a Special 2 Lock. When Zola finishes a Special Attack, he inflicts the selected effect as a Passive for 20 seconds.
If neither Pre-Fight is selected, during the Opponent's Special Attacks they are inflicted with a 30% Cowardice Debuff. As a Defender, this becomes a 90% Cowardice Passive.

abilitySections.title: ESP Box - Sleep
content: When Zola is struck by anything other than a Heavy Attack, he gains an indefinite ESP Charge. When Zola Blocks any hit, he gains 3 Charges. Max stacks: 30.

20+ Charges: Before being hit by a Basic Attack, Zola has a 10% chance to consume all ESP Charges and inflict a Sleep Passive for 3 seconds. For each Charge over 20, the chance is increased by +5% flat. During a Well-Timed Block, the chance is increased to 100%.
If Zola is knocked down by a Heavy Attack, he loses 10 ESP Charges.

abilitySections.title: Disintegration Gauntlets - Heavy Attacks
content: The first hit of Zola's Heavy Attack inflicts a 0.5% Disintegration Debuff dealing [296.25] Direct Damage over 0.5 seconds. If the Opponent was not Stunned, inflict 5 additional Debuffs.
While the Opponent is suffering from any of these Disintegration Debuffs, all of Zola's hits inflict another Disintegration Debuff.
These Disintegration Debuffs are paused while Zola is charging or performing a Heavy or Special Attack, and the final hit of Zola's Special Attacks removes them.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation, gain a 10% Energize Passive for 60 seconds. Max stacks: 5.
The first hit grants a +[2,962.5] Fury Buff for 4 seconds, paused until the start of Zola's next Special Attack.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: On activation, inflict a 40% Disintegration Passive dealing [4,937.5] Direct Damage over 10 seconds.
Each buzzsaw hit consumes 1 of Zola's personal Energizes to inflict a 10% Disintegration Passive dealing [11,850] Direct Damage over 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Inflict an Armor Break Debuff, reducing Armor Rating by [1,178.57] for 20 seconds. Max stacks: 5.
Gain a Self-Repair Passive healing 100% of Zola's missing Health over 20 seconds. This Self-Repair is lost if Zola is Stunned.
For each time this Special Attack has been used previously in the Quest, these effects' base durations are tripled. Zola's anti-exponential algorithms won't let this increase more than 3 times.
